title: RWAT golden case file
description: A file of cases of fixtures/golden/<folder>/ (fixtures/golden/README.md): one piece of logic the engine, the converter and the editor share, each case an input and what the reference makes of it. A folder's ports.json follows #/$defs/ports.

description.description: What logic the file holds (the reference's class and method), what its inputs hold and what its expected.

frame.description: The frame the expected's places are in: obj (the pack's, as Blender shows the model), model (the engine's, stock.ObjFrame), none (no places). Markup in an input is always in the OBJ frame; a question asked of a result (a point to test) is in the frame of the expected.

tolerance.description: How far a port's number may be from the expected, absolute. The reference compares exactly.

id.description: Stable, unique in its folder: the name of the case in the reports of every port.

note.description: What the case is there for.

input.description: The input as the engine reads it: text of an OBJ, MTL or .anim as a string, object names as strings, a type as the pack's JSON (OBJ frame).

input_file.description: Files of the example pack the input is read from, by their path from the repository root: a string is the whole input, an object puts each file under its key of input. A .json file is read as JSON, any other as its text (UTF-8).

expected.description: What the reference makes of the input; written by the reference (its update flag), never by hand. NaN and the infinities as the strings NaN, Infinity, -Infinity.

packFile.description: A file of the example pack (CC0): the only files a case may read; nothing of MVP.

finding.description: What the engine tells a pack author, as the editor shows it (FloorCheck, the type reader): code, the subject and its index (-1: none), the params the text is made of, the text. Fields the engine doesn't give yet are null.

ports.description: fixtures/golden/<folder>/ports.json: who writes the expected (reference) and who checks against it (ports); the meta-test of each suite checks that every folder naming its language is read by its runner.
